derived.light: text.muted = Deep Ocean at 76 % over Ivory; surface.subtle = Sand at 16 % over Ivory; border.strong = Deep Ocean at 56 % over Ivory (3.4:1 — meets the 3:1 non-text minimum for input boundaries); accent.rule and border are decorative and are never the only indicator of a boundary or state. State colours are retained from v
derived.dark: surface.card = Deep Ocean mixed 8 % toward white; text.muted = Ivory at 72 % over Deep Ocean; brand.emerald = Emerald lifted 58 % toward Ivory so that it clears 4.5:1 on cards; state.error.text = #F5A3A6 is used for error copy on Deep Ocean (the fill #E5484D is reserved for icons and borders).
